What we do

Pest control that covers the whole house

From fleas in the carpet to termites in the walls — one call handles it.

Flea Treatment

Fleas in the carpet, on the pets, in the yard. We treat the home and the source, so they don't come back.

Ant Removal

Sugar ants, carpenter ants and odorous house ants — tracked to the colony and eliminated, not just sprayed at the trail.

Wasp & Bee Removal

Nests under eaves, in walls and in the ground, removed safely — without putting your family at risk.

Spider Control

De-webbing, barrier treatments and crack-and-crevice work that keeps spiders out of your living spaces.

Termite Control

Sentricon termite baiting from a Certified Sentricon Specialist, plus inspections that catch damage early.

Rodent Removal

Trapping, exclusion and entry-point sealing. We solve the rodent problem instead of just catching one mouse.

About us

Portland's local pest control company since 1982

The Killers Pest Control is a locally-owned company founded in 1982, and a trusted name in pest management in Portland, OR. Our professional pest control technicians are courteous, clean, experienced and knowledgeable — and happy to answer any pest control questions you have.

From thorough inspections to effective treatments and preventive measures, our goal is to provide long-lasting pest solutions that bring peace of mind to your home or business.

  • Free pest inspection before any work
  • Most work guaranteed for up to a year
  • Certified Sentricon Specialist on staff
  • Courteous, clean, experienced technicians
